info.name: gp-connect-access-record-structured-fhir Appointment Documents API
info.version: Computed and injected at build time by `scripts/set_version.py`

info.name: Find a patient by NHS number on the Access Document FHIR server

params.name: id
params.description: The NHS Number of the patient you are searching for.

items.docs:
Use this endpoint to find a Patient.

If searching for a Patient's document this endpoint must be used to obtain the correct patient id from the provider system.

No request body is required for this endpoint.

info.name: Get a specific document from a GP practice

params.name: id
params.description: The id of the document you are searching for.

params.name: patientNHSNumber
params.description: The NHS number of the patient to whom the document belongs.

items.docs: Use this endpoint to retrieve a specific document using the id.  The NHS number of the patient is also required as a query string parameter. No request body is required for this endpoint.
